description: Defines the ResolveContext class and related components for DNS resolution management within the net namespace, including server iteration, session handling, and failure tracking.

classes.name: ResolveContext
classes.description: Manages DNS resolution sessions, server iteration, failure tracking, and observer notifications within a URLRequestContext.

classes.name: ResolveContext::DohStatusObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in DoH server session status and availability.

classes.name: ResolveContext::ServerStats
classes.description: Tracks runtime statistics for each DNS server, including failure counts, success status, RTT histogram, and last response times.

methods.name: GetDohIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for DoH DNS servers based on current config, mode, and session.

methods.name: GetClassicDnsIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for classic DNS servers based on current config and session.

methods.name: GetDohServerAvailability
methods.description: Checks if a specific DoH server is available for use in automatic mode based on failure count and session.

methods.name: NumAvailableDohServers
methods.description: Returns the count of available DoH servers for the current session.

methods.name: RecordServerFailure
methods.description: Records a failure response from a server, updating failure counts and server availability.

methods.name: RecordServerSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful response from a server.

methods.name: RecordRtt
methods.description: Records the round-trip time for a server response.

methods.name: NextClassicFallbackPeriod
methods.description: Calculates fallback period before retrying classic DNS server.

methods.name: NextDohFallbackPeriod
methods.description: Calculates fallback period before retrying DoH server.

methods.name: ClassicTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Provides timeout duration for insecure DNS transactions.

methods.name: SecureTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Provides timeout duration for secure DNS transactions based on mode.

methods.name: RegisterDohStatusObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for DoH server status changes.

methods.name: UnregisterDohStatusObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for DoH server status changes.

methods.name: InvalidateCachesAndPerSessionData
methods.description: Clears cached data and updates session info, typically on network change.

methods.name: GetTargetNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle for DNS lookups; virtual for testing.
